title: Why ideas matter more than ever: four types of ideas that win when AI makes execution cheap
summary: Greg argues that with AI making software building effortless, execution is no longer the bottleneck; ideas are. He defines four idea types (distribution, niche, startup, creative) and gives concrete habits for mining, collecting and generating them.

principles.text: When AI makes building cheap, the idea becomes the bottleneck, not execution.
principles.quote: In a world where AI makes turning ideas into software businesses borderline effortless, execution isn’t the bottleneck anymore. It’s the idea itself.

principles.text: Distribution often beats product quality; a strong distribution idea can make an obscure product win.
principles.quote: Remember, the best product doesn't always win, the best distribution often does.

principles.text: Mine social platforms and data tools for hyper-specific niches that big players ignore.
principles.quote: Find a $10M+/year business, pick off a smaller niche and get to building.

principles.text: Copy a fast-growing startup's distribution strategy and apply it in an unknown space.
principles.quote: Find a fast growing startup and use their distribution strategy in an unknown space.

principles.text: Use AI to deliver highly personalized, bespoke-feeling services as the new baseline for startups.
principles.quote: AI doesn’t just automate tasks, it redefines what’s possible. Imagine startups that can offer services so personalized, they feel bespoke.

principles.text: Don't wait for lightbulb moments; keep a swipe file of ideas by category and capture whatever you see.
principles.quote: Keep a note file on your phone called ideas. Have sections for distribution ideas, niche ideas, startup ideas, creative days.
